left.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
left.claim: RT-2 represents robot actions as text tokens and co-fine-tunes them with Internet-scale vision-language tasks.

source_locator.quote: we represent robot actions as another language, which can be cast into text tokens and trained together with Internet-scale vision-language datasets

right.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
right.claim: OpenVLA predicts 7-dimensional robot control actions with fused DINOv2 and SigLIP features projected into a Llama 2 backbone.

source_locator.quote: the model predicts 7-dimensional robot control actions

items.rationale: Both claims concern token-decoded VLA control; OpenVLA changes the open architecture, fused visual encoder, scale, and adaptation surface.

left.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
left.claim: Octo uses a transformer with task and observation tokens, readout tokens, and replaceable output heads for downstream action spaces.

source_locator.quote: readout tokens that get passed to output heads to produce actions

right.title: Dita: Scaling Diffusion Transformer for Generalist Vision-Language-Action Policy
right.claim: Dita directly denoises continuous action sequences with in-context conditioning instead of a compact action head conditioned on fused embeddings.

source_locator.quote: the proposed Dita architecture that denoises actions inherently in an in-context conditioning style

items.rationale: Dita explicitly positions its diffusion transformer as a change to the compact action-head family represented by Octo and related policies.

left.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
left.claim: DPO extracts the optimal policy in closed form and directly optimizes preferences with a classification objective instead of a separate reward model and reinforcement learning loop.

source_locator.quote: DPO directly optimizes for the policy best satisfying the preferences with a simple classification objective

right.title: DeepSeek LLM: Scaling Open-Source Language Models with Longtermism
right.claim: DeepSeek applies supervised fine-tuning and DPO to its base models to create DeepSeek Chat models.

source_locator.quote: We further conduct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on DeepSeek LLM Base models

items.rationale: The second paper reports using the DPO method in a new model-training pipeline; this is method adoption, not proof of identical experimental claims.
